name: rosetta
description: Repo-root delegator + tooling. Railway uses build/start scripts here (with the root railway.json) to deploy the whole repo and run the backend; the runtime needs site/ and registry/ as siblings of backend/dist. validate-registry + dev are repo-tooling scripts unrelated to the deploy.

scripts.build: cd backend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run start
